xml_issues: Generates a new <image> element for every annotation instead of grouping multiple boxes under a single frame tag
Duplicate image IDs and names will cause CVAT import validation errors due to non-unique frame identifiers
video_name parameter is passed to create_cvat_xml but never utilized in the generated structure
memory_concerns: Accumulates all annotations in an unbounded Python list before serialization, risking OOM on long videos or high detection rates
Uses minidom.parseString() to pretty-print the entire XML document in memory simultaneously with ElementTree, doubling peak RAM usage during export

issues.description: XML structure violates CVAT schema by creating multiple <image> nodes per frame instead of nesting boxes within a single image node per frame
In-memory accumulation of annotations lacks streaming or chunked writing support for large datasets
File write operation uses direct overwrite without temporary file or atomic commit, risking data corruption on process interruption
